title: Apple supplier shares sink on latest news - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text: Apple supplier shares sink on latest news Dec. 6, 2018 4:00 AM ET | About: Apple Inc. (AAPL) | By: Yoel Minkoff , SA News Editor More Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) woes? Supplier shares took a beating overnight after Taiwan's Largan Precision ( OTC:LGANF ), a leading lens supplier of smartphone cameras, reported a more than 25% Y/Y decline in its November revenue. The Tawainese company plunged 10% on the news, triggering a sector selloff across Asia. Apple's share price has suffered since its Q3 earnings, with analysts maintaining the company's "iconic hardware unit growth is broadly over for now."
